proposals.evidence: DEDR3213 explicitly gives Kota tiŋgḷ month and Kannada tiŋgaḷ moon/month. Survey Badaga tiŋguva and Kota tiŋgulu are comparative month forms of that lunar family with source liquid and final-vowel notation preserved. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR3263(a) documents tiṉ/tinn- eat, with Tamil past tiṉṟ-, Kannada tind-, Kodagu timb-/tind-, Kota/Toda tiḏ- and Gadaba tin-/tiy-/tinḍ-. Selected simple and ordinary tense/nominal forms retain that eat stem and its documented alternants; survey endings, voicing and vowels are preserved. Longer auxiliary/pronoun clauses and uncertain rounded-vowel forms are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR4205 gives Tamil piṉ, Malayalam pimpu, Kota pibal/piga·r and Kannada pinde/him behind. These southern pin-/pimp-/pih-/in(d)- survey responses retain the documented back/behind stem with ordinary locative extensions and regular Kannada-area loss of initial p/h. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
